title: Sharp asymptotic upper bounds for sphere packing
abstract: Formalizes the sharp high-dimensional asymptotics of the unrestricted Cohn--Elkies linear program and bridges them to sphere-packing density. The development constructs radial test functions through Mellin, saddle-point, and harmonic analysis, proves radialization preserves the unrestricted optimum, and certifies the exact natural- and base-two exponential rates.

informal.PackingBounds.FullMain.exact_limit: The d-th root of the unrestricted Cohn--Elkies linear-program bound converges to the sharp constant sqrt(e / (2 pi)).
informal.PackingBounds.FullMain.exact_binary_expo: The base-two logarithm of the unrestricted linear-program bound, divided by dimension, converges to -1/2 log_2(2 pi / e).
informal.PackingBounds.PackingBridge.sphere_packi: There is a vanishing error sequence such that, in every positive dimension, sphere-packing density is at most (sqrt(e / (2 pi)) plus that error) to the dimension.
informal.PackingBounds.sharpFullCohnElkiesManuscr: Packages the complete sharp asymptotic conclusions for the unrestricted program, including quotient-root, natural-logarithmic, and base-two limits, vanishing-error formulas, a universal bound for all admissible functions, and a certified decimal exponent interval.
